Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 700 PM EST Fri Nov 13 2026
 

- A mix of rain and snow showers will affect the eastern portions of 
the thumb tonight. Minor accumulations on grassy surfaces are 
possible.

- Mostly cloudy skies will prevail this weekend with seasonally cool 
temperatures. 

- Dry and mild weather will dominate much of next week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Low level drying and winds shifting more out of northwest brings 
improved ceilings and pushes the lingering lake effect showers well 
to the east of the terminal corridor. Expecting VFR ceilings to 
prevail through the majority of tonight until persistent northwest 
flow carries BKN/OVC coverage of borderline MVFR/VFR stratus into 
southeast Michigan tomorrow morning. These ceilings are expected to 
hold through the day with the persistent northwest wind to around 10 
knots. 

For DTW...Mostly VFR ceiling into tonight. Borderline MVFR/VFR 
ceilings return tomorrow morning between 11 and 15Z and hold through 
the day.  

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Low for ceilings at or below 5,000 feet tonight, high tomorrow.

&&
